items.title: Iran's flogging of singer was warning from anxious hardliners, insiders say
items.summary: By Parisa Hafezi, Emily Giles and Melory Ghazi DUBAI, Nov 28 (Reuters) - Iran's flogging of a female singer this week for offending public decency was a display of force by an embattled clerical elite straining to uphold public obedience it once took for granted, Iranian insiders say.
